# Synthetic media fixtures

`kwm-legacy-synthetic.bin` is a synthetic interoperability fixture, not a vendor/client download or a copyrighted recording. Its 0.1 s, 440 Hz mono WAV was generated by the pinned FFmpeg runtime. An independent PowerShell wrapper followed the legacy KWM structure in `Magiicccc/music-batch-unlock` commit `837c2ccd09d85eb0ae96132e96b84d2e5897b4c6`, `src/decrypt/kwm.ts` (MIT; notice in docs/third_party).

The header is 1024 bytes, magic `yeelion-kuwo-tme`, unsigned little-endian test value 1234567890123456789 at offset 24. The public format mask and repeating decimal test value are XORed with the audio. This is public format data, not an account credential or application signing key.

Wrapped SHA-256: `0218bf11f8d006a801d666cf81d6a36e7cd5defc86e247a008b6f92436a0f591`.
Unwrapped WAV SHA-256: `52cd6966017dd2f58c47c6e219ec63b1e812457004b7929c07d96e6608de1817`.

Tests verify native probing, codec, sample rate, duration, full decoding, input byte preservation and staging cleanup. This does not establish compatibility with current KWM client variants; the adapter remains Experimental.
